about: Budgets for `npm run bench:check`. `median` is the limit; `mainMedian` is the larger of two full runs on main (this machine, see docs/performance-budgets.md). Time budgets are mainMedian x 1.3 rounded up; bundle sizes are deterministic, so x 1.1. To tighten one after an improvement, rerun `npm run bench` twice and set `median` to the larger new median x 1.3 (x 1.1 for bundles); update `mainMedian` to match.
